description: Slice #4 COMPOSED FLAT-PATTERN SHEET golden for the authored U-channel (base flange + TWO edge flanges off the same base — the depth-1-star N=2 case). The same feature tree the u-channel-flat-pattern-view golden evaluates is COMPOSED onto a sheet (drawing-export.md §4.2 / sheet-metal.md §7): the additive flat-pattern branch of place_sheet places the single flat blank CENTRED plus a two-row bend-table block. Proves the composed flat-pattern sheet scales to N>1 bends through the SAME pipeline, with edge_role preserved and the bend table clear of the blank.
derivation: The flat pattern is a rectangle: 4 body edges (edge_role='body') plus one fold line per bend (edge_role='bend'). For the N=2 U-channel: body_edge_count = 4, bend_edge_count = 2. view_to_svg_edges carries edge_role THROUGH placement, so the composed edge list preserves the two bend strokes.

Layout: A4 landscape (297x210 mm), one flat_pattern view placement, title 'U-Channel Flat Pattern', scale 1:1. The blank is placed CENTRED on the sheet (anchor = sheet centre 148.5, 105.0). The bend-table block is anchored at the top-left margin corner (10, 10), clear of the centred blank (asserted non-overlapping the blank bbox).

The bend_table on the ComposedSheet carries two BendTableRows (bend-1, bend-2), in the unfold's deterministic fold-position order (positional correlation to the edge_role='bend' edges, §6): each 90 deg, radius 3 mm, up, BA 6.094689747964199 mm — the analytic nominals hand-derived in ../u-channel-edge-flange/expected.json.

content_hash is the sha256 of the composed ComposedSheet.model_dump_json() (place_sheet output, scale 1:1, the fixed layout above) — a DETERMINISM PIN reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (§9 #4). Version-pinned like the unfold golden.

2026-07-31 (BACKLOG #50): content_hash regenerated WITHOUT a kernel bump, which the pin above otherwise calls a P0. The cause is a MODEL-SHAPE change, not a determinism regression: ComposedSheet gained the additive optional thread_schedule field, so model_dump_json() now emits "thread_schedule":null for a sheet that has none. The composed PLACEMENT is unchanged and the serialized SVG/PDF/DXF artifact bytes for these two goldens are unchanged except for the N5 white page fill — both verified.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set. Centring residual is floating-point only (<1e-12); the bend-table values are the exact unfold outputs (~1.2e-13 vs the analytic nominals, matching ../u-channel-edge-flange/expected.json). The 1e-9 ceiling gives ~3 orders of headroom while staying tighter than the standing kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m).
title: U-Channel Flat Pattern
